title: CodeFlow trusted-base project checks
description: The project-owned declaration .codeflow/base-checks.json. The managed CI runs each check from the trusted commit's own copies of its script and inputs (the default branch on GitHub, the target commit elsewhere) before it judges a pull request, with the base, head and merge commits and the head repository as arguments; a failing, missing or unreadable check fails the required check. `codeflow update` never writes this file.

checks.description: The checks, run in this order.

name.description: A short name, unique in the file.

script.description: The script, a path from the project root; a regular file on the trusted commit, never a symbolic link or gitlink.

interpreter.description: A bare command found on the runner's PATH, such as bash, sh, python3 or node; it runs `<interpreter> <script> <base> <head> <merge> <head-repo>`.

inputs.description: Files or folders the script reads, exported from the trusted commit beside it.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the check is stopped and fails; 300 when absent.

audit_exception_inputs.description: Files the dependency-audit exception hook .codeflow/audit-exceptions.sh reads, such as its register, so `codeflow ci` names a change to them.

path.description: A relative path inside the repository, written with forward slashes, with no empty, `.` or `..` part and outside .git.
